name: 01473 · Westminster, MA
findings: ZIP 01473 (Westminster) has 19 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01473 (Westminster) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
